_comment: Public OAuth client credentials shipped by Google's antigravity-cli. Per RFC 8252 (OAuth for Native Apps) and Google's installed-app docs, these identify the client application, not the end user, and are intentionally embedded in the redistributable — they are NOT secrets. We mirror upstream's values verbatim so token refresh works against the same client_id antigravity's auth flow registered. The refresh_token grant does not take a scope parameter (Google returns the originally granted scopes), so scope is intentionally omitted here. If Google rotates these upstream, mirror the new values. Treat this file as configuration, not a credential.
